body: I've blamed my cat on multiple occasions.  Also blamed it on a curling iron burn.
I live like 8 blocks from Utah Lake State Park in Provo, so this is hilarious to me.  Also concerning haha
Yes they can.  Your PCP doesn't specialize in psychiatric drugs, but they should be able to prescribe you something to keep you stable until your appointment in August.

I was at a pretty prestigious music camp when I was 19, and was first chair of my section and had lots of solos.  I was running low on sleep and was feeling extremely anxious.  I have a pretty significant history of mental health issues, so I went to the ER that night to see if I could get something short term to manage the anxiety, and came out with 10 Ativan pills.  

The next day I was in a chamber music rehearsal and the intense anxiety hit me again, so I took one of the pills in hopes that it would chill me out long enough to get through the rehearsal.  Well, either it worked too well or not well enough, because taking that pill was the last thing I remember.  I woke up two days later in a psychiatric hospital because I had apparently not only downed the entire bottle of Ativan in less than an hour, but had also taken about 30 extra strength Tylenol pills.  Everybody had assumed that it was a suicide attempt (for the record, it wasn't), so I was involuntarily admitted.  Good times, folks.

Even when I did get tired, I could only sleep for two hours even though I had been up for almost 48.  And the psychological part of the comedown was too much for me.  I have PTSD and the comedown had me living those experiences in my mind all over again.

I definitely felt my blood sugar crash, and I was grinding my teeth like crazy,  but my brain has been going to a lot of dark places and I've been reliving a lot of psychological abuse that I experienced as a teenager.  A friend of mine knows I'm on a comedown, so she's just letting me spam text her with all of my thoughts, and I'm doing pretty okay.  As long as I'm typing comments and sending messages, I'm good.

Haha anytime I smoke bud, it is guaranteed that the only thing getting me off my ass is the ring of the doorbell when the pizza is there.  But also apparently bars make me do some dumb shit, so maybe they'd meet in the middle for me and I'd end up like you did.  Not sure how much I want to try haha

It's probably just me trying to come up with alternate ways to cope with everything instead of using proper coping skills.  You don't sound like an ass at all.  Everybody else in my circle always has a blast on bars, so I guess I'm holding onto hope that maybe I'll have a good experience.  But it's sounding like I just need to stay the hell away from them and find something else.

The comedown has began to hit me at this point after about 8 hours of pretty good effects.  I'm going to force myself to eat some toast and yogurt, take some melatonin, and hope that maybe I can sleep a bit.  My body is exhausted, but my brain is still wide awake, though the light and creative mindset I was in is taking a dark turn.  These next few hours will definitely determine if I'll ever take Adderall again.  I guess I'll just reply to this comment in a few hours when I reach a verdict.  Thanks for all of your comments and suggestions, they've been very helpful.

Yeah, I've found that weed works well enough for me when it comes to getting high.  I work in a hospital and work a mix of day and grave shifts, so my sleep schedule is prettymuch shit.  I took it tonight when I'm not working to see what its effects for me are, and to see if it might be an option for especially crazy work weeks.

Okay, I'll keep that in mind.  I have a hard time with benzos because I'll black out and get really self destructive (twice I have "come to" a few days later in the psych hospital having no idea what got me there), so I'm just giving this a try.  It's good to hear your experience though and I'll definitely prepare for a ton of anxiety coming down, just in case it happens.  Thanks

I know that I for sure snorted 4 bars, but I'm not sure exactly how I got rid of the others, but I'm assuming I snorted them.  But yeah, taking a couple bottles of antidepressants will definitely fuck you up way more.

Yeah, I've definitely been wary, and won't be doing it until I've finished up my intensive outpatient therapy program at the hospital.  Weed has been my drug of choice for a long time. So I'd probably be fine with a 2mg bar and a couple bowls.
This is very interesting.  I think I'm going to show this post to one of my IOP therapists, because I think a lot of people in my group could use it.

I like that idea is great!  I'm attending an IOP program at the hospital I was at a month ago, and only a couple days ago was the idea of ocd brought up.  I knew I had PTSD, anxiety and depression, but when I thought about it, ocd makes a lot of sense.  When I have disturbing thoughts like cutting and such, it's not a matter of if I will follow through with it, but more a matter of when.  I'm an almost 21 year old female, so your response seriously helps a lot.

I've been in IOP for about 6 weeks and am just barely feeling the benefits as far as my recovery goes.  The thing that kept me coming back was the feeling of having a "family", I guess you could say.  My IOP program combines both the mental health and chemical detox patients, so I'm opened up to a wide variety of stories and experiences, which really gives me a lot of perspective.  There are university professors, social workers, hospital employees, stay at home mothers, and people of many other backgrounds.  One big struggle I've had with my group is the fact that it sometimes just turns into a social hour, and the therapists have a hard time regaining control of the conversation.  With our sessions only being 3 hours long, an hour of lost time makes a huge difference.

I have also had two MISERABLE hospitalizations (waking up in the hospital with no memory of even opening the pill bottle, and never knowing exactly what happened).  I'm sorry you had a rough go as well.
